The '''Arbran lava snail''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]],<ref name="A Culinary Caution" /> a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030605arbra|text=Arbra: Sanctuary In the Storm|int=Arbra: Sanctuary In the Storm}}</ref> The [[Snail/Legends|snail]] lived atop Arbra's [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]]. Arbran [[Magma/Legends|lava]] snails were potentially [[Death/Legends|lethal]] when used as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and were consequentially banned by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="A Culinary Caution" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel}}
Nevertheless, in [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}. According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] take place in [[3638 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "A Culinary Caution" is part of the ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'' expansion and therefore also takes place in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> an underworld [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] that specialized in serving forbidden [[Diet/Legends|entrees]] wished to add the Arbran lava snail to its menu, and subsequently an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing conflict sent a companion to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] down some of the creatures on Arbra.<ref name="A Culinary Caution" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Arbran lava snail was introduced in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="A Culinary Caution" />
